config_name: Galaxy Tab S10+ — Dimensity 9300+, 12GB RAM, 256GB, 12.4" Dynamic AMOLED 2X + Slim Keyboard Cover (priced in)

specs.ports: 1x USB-C 3.2 (DP out, DeX), pogo pins for keyboard cover — no 3.5mm, no HDMI
specs.keyboard_notes: Slim Keyboard Cover (BBY 18469762) included in price: scissor keys, NO trackpad (trackpad only on the $299 Book Cover Keyboard); pogo-pin powered, no charging
specs.pen_support: S Pen INCLUDED in box (Bluetooth air actions, IP68)
specs.os: Android 14 (One UI 6.1) at launch; 7 years OS + security updates promised; Samsung DeX desktop mode

battery.notes: 10,090mAh. Lab Wi-Fi-web runs ~12-14h; users report ~9-11h mixed real use. 45W charging, ~2h to full.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tab S10+ 256GB $1,499.99 (BBY SKU 18390513) + Slim Keyboard Cover $219.97 reg (BBY 18469762, sale $131.97) = $1,719.96 cover-in price. Cover-only price: $219.97 reg / $131.97 sale.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 1499.99 + keyboard per price.notes.
Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+ Gray 256GB (CAD Version)

reviews.quote: The AI tablet has a display problem: developed specially for AI functions, but Samsung is breaking new ground with its choice of processor.

praises: DeX desktop mode with the keyboard cover: real multi-window desktop UI on a 12.4" AMOLED — the closest Android gets to a laptop (r/Samsung)
S Pen in the box at zero extra cost — users constantly contrast this with Apple's +$169 Pencil
Galaxy phone parity: Quick Share, Second Screen as a PC monitor, auto call/text relay — continuity rivals Apple within the Galaxy bubble
Quad AKG speakers are loud and clean enough to skip a Bluetooth speaker
microSD slot AND IP68 in a flagship — pool-safe with expandable storage Apple dropped and even Samsung's own S11 line dropped
complaints: DeX is per-app: banking apps and many popular apps refuse to window, and Chrome has no desktop mode (Samsung Internet does) — desktop promise is half-kept
Slim Keyboard Cover has NO trackpad — the mouse/trackpad tax means the $299 Book Cover Keyboard for a real typing setup
AMOLED PWM flicker at low brightness bothers light-sensitive readers in dark rooms
Dimensity 9300+ is only a modest uplift over the S9's Snapdragon — some GPU benchmarks actually regressed
No headphone jack; USB-C audio dongle dangles when the keyboard cover is on

design_philosophy: Samsung's flagship all-rounder slate: best-in-class AMOLED, included S Pen, IP68, and a 7-year update pledge, with DeX as its laptop-substitution pitch. This 256GB + Slim Keyboard tier is the volume buy — the price includes the entry keyboard, which buys typing but not a trackpad, so the honest laptop config is $80-170 more.
rating_notes: Ratings anchored on the NBC-reviewed S10+ launch config per SHARED-tab-s10.md; no verbatim pro score retrievable (NBC/RTINGS bot-walled 2026-11-24 — disclosed, none invented). Ecosystem 7.0 = DeX + Galaxy-phone parity strong but Android tablet app gap; keyboard_trackpad 5.5 = priced-in Slim cover has good keys but no trackpad (real user gripe). microSD lifts upgradability above iPad peers. Image URL is BBY CDN SKU guess.
standouts: DeX + included S Pen + IP68 + microSD — no other 12" flagship combines all four
7-year OS/security update pledge (through ~2031) at a mid-laptop price
dealbreakers: Trackpad requires the pricier $299 Book Cover Keyboard — the priced-in cover is keys-only
